messages:
dara (Support): Escalation: welcome emails failing for a small set of EU tenants after this morning's mail provider change. Affected trial accounts: NimbusCo, CedarLane. They can reach the site but can't finish verification.

maya (CS): Acknowledged. Do we have a clear root cause or just delivery failures?

dara (Support): Outbound logs show 550/relay errors from the new provider starting ~08:47 UTC. No downstream spam reports yet.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4120 and attached SMTP logs + provider config diff.

nate (CS Manager): Maya, please lead customer outreach. Olivia, flag for renewals if these are high-touch trials.

maya (CS): On it. Can Support manually activate accounts if customers request immediate access?

dara (Support): Yes—there is an admin toggle to mark accounts verified. We'll only use it after explicit consent.

olivia (AE): If activation is delayed >48 hours we should treat as potential renewal risk and offer a mitigation (credit or extended trial). I'll prepare suggested language.

sara (Enablement): Temporary workaround we validated in staging: enable allow_unverified_emails=true and requeue outgoing welcome jobs. Example: 

curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/admin/requeue-welcome" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT_ID>"}'

Ops must monitor bounce volume if used. Documented in playbook.

dara (Support): Testing workaround now on dev tenant. Will report results in 10m.

infra-bot: INFRA-4120 updated: workaround approved for scoped emergency rollout.

nate (CS Manager): Internal comms plan:
- Maya: send customer note within 20m, include activation and onboarding options.
- Olivia: follow up with AE outreach & renewal tagging.
- Support: manual activation only after consent.
- Infra/Ops: apply workaround in batches and monitor metrics.

maya (CS): Draft message for review: 

---
Hi <Customer>,
We discovered an issue that prevented our welcome email from delivering. We can either activate your account manually so you can start now, or retry sending the verification email after we fix delivery. If you'd like, we can also schedule a brief onboarding call and offer a one-month credit for the disruption. Please reply with your preference and we'll take care of it immediately.
Thanks,
Maya (Customer Success)
---

olivia (AE): LGTM. For enterprise trials, call out the credit proactively.

dara (Support): Update: NimbusCo asked for manual activation + onboarding session; CedarLane requested retry first.

dara (Support): Manual activation applied for NimbusCo after consent, onboarding scheduled for tomorrow. CedarLane queued for retry; first resend attempted just now.

infra-bot: Monitoring alert created: eu-west-1 email-bounce-rate > 0.7% — paging eng-email if not resolved in 15m.

sara (Enablement): Playbook updated with emergency steps and AE compensation guidance: https://confluence.internal/redwood/cs/playbooks/email-failures

nate (CS Manager): Nicely coordinated. Keep this thread updated with customer replies and timing. We'll run a short postmortem and adjust onboarding SLAs if needed. :thumbsup:
